mentions.heading: Future growth depends on making the right investments at the right time
mentions.detail: Substantial investments targeting China/Asia Pacific and ADAS, autonomous driving, software, high voltage electrification; losses possible if markets underperform
mentions.quote: If we are unable to deepen existing and develop additional customer relationships in the Asia Pacific region, or if we are unable to develop and introduce market-relevant advanced driver assistance or autonomous driving technologies, we may not only fail to realize expected rates of return on our existing investments, but we may incur losses on such investments and be unable to timely redeploy the invested capital to take advantage of other markets or product categories, potentially resulting in lost market share to our competitors.
